observation.command: echo "root threads: [$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.threads 2>/dev/null)]"; echo "docker threads: [$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.threads 2>/dev/null)]"; echo "docker subtree_control: [$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.subtree_control 2>/dev/null)]"; echo "root subtree_control: [$(cat /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.subtree_control 2>/dev/null)]"; echo "docker procs: $(wc -l < /sys/fs/cgroup/docker/cgroup.procs 2>/dev/null)"; echo "write test:"; (echo 0 > /sys/fs/cgroup/cgroup.threads) 2>&1 && echo "root threads set to 0 OK" || echo "cannot write root threads"
